### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Persona (as the simulator would state it): Odalys Brennecke-Faure, phone 6305550174; cabinets bought in January on a special order "on your Ridgeline Preferred card with the twelve-month no-interest financing"; wants "your automatic payments set up so the cabinet financing is completely paid off before that period ends ... switched to a fixed monthly amount"; "not making a one-time payment today, and you do not want anything else changed". Identity: ZIP 60540, DOB 1983-07-26 (SSN4 2148 only if asked). Card ending 4471; receipt SO-0418-552063; bank stays ending 3906. Passive conditionals: "If the representative tells you that something has to be put right on the account before the payment plan can be worked out, you say that is fine, they have your go-ahead"; "when the representative hands the autopay setting over to you and tells you the fixed amount, you put it through exactly as they give it to you". The simulator never supplies a figure. Target object, action boundary (autopay to fixed amount for payoff), timing (now) and authorisation mode (customer runs the autopay change) are clear.

### 4. Scored parameters

Window anchors with today 2026-10-12: "less than 3 full months" → after 2026-07-12; "12 full months" → after 2025-10-12. Full months open from 2021-02-17: 67.

**A. Return credit amount (hop 1).** Visible rule (refund_return_credit_amount): "the uncredited refund plus a late-posting allowance, rounded to the nearest cent"; uncredited refund = refunds to the card tender in 3 months less return credits on the account in the same 3 months.
- Uncredited refund: 363.00 − 0.00 = 363.00.
- Allowance rate (refund_allowance_rate): "Card Preferred or Card Premier | 60 or more | the account's purchase APR" → 67 months → 29.99 (interest_rate_schedule, Card Preferred). Evidence: account variant 'Card Preferred', opened_date '2021-02-17'.
- Late-posting clock (refund_late_posting_clock): "When the refunds to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the 3 months are the payout of vendor-delay credits — that is, the vendor-delay credits the special order program applied in the same 3 months total exactly the same amount as those refunds — the clock starts on the latest of those delay-credit dates." Refunds 363.00 = delay_credit 363.00 (2026-09-21) → clock starts 2026-09-21 → 21 days.
- Interest part: 363.00 × 29.99/100 × 21/365 = 6.2634 → 6.26.
- Flat courtesy (refund_flat_courtesy): days from the latest refund date (2026-09-24) to today = 18 → "14 to 29 | 7.50"; "added to the interest part … once that interest part has been rounded" → 13.76.
- Multiplier (refund_special_order_spending_multiplier): special-order-channel purchases on the account in 12 months = 7260.00 → "total 5000.00 or more | 2"; "The late-posting allowance — its interest part together with any amount added to it — is multiplied … rounded to the nearest cent" → 27.52.
- Return credit = 363.00 + 27.52 = **390.52**.
- Fall-back (computation document alone): 363.00 × 6/100 × 18/365 = 1.07 → 364.07. Definite and different.

**B. Fixed draft amount (root).** Visible rule (payoff_autopay_draft_amount): "the deferred-interest balance increased by 5 percent and divided by the number of the plan's due dates, rounded up to the next whole dollar."
- Deferred-interest balance: 7260.00 purchases on deferred plans − return credits carrying a deferred plan code (390.52, the hop-1 credit, plan 'deferred_12') − payments "allocated to a deferred-interest balance at the cardholder's request" (1200.00 on 2026-05-20 and 900.00 on 2026-08-21, both 'deferred_promo_requested') = 4769.48.
- Plan end date: 2027-01-19 (only plan). Due dates on day 9 (latest statement 2026-09-14, due 2026-10-09, not after today): 2026-11-09, 2026-12-09, 2027-01-09 → 3.
- Plan margin (payoff_plan_margin): "Card Preferred or Card Premier | 36 or more | 1 percent" → 67 months → 1 % → 4817.1748.
- Number of drafts (payoff_plan_payment_history): no returned payment in 12 months; late fee 32.00 dated 2026-03-12 (fee_type 'late_fee') → "no payment returned unpaid, but a late fee was charged … multiplied by 0.75 and rounded down" → floor(2.25) = 2.
- 4817.1748 / 2 = 2408.587 → rounded up 2409.00.
- Spending add-on (payoff_standard_purchase_addon): standard-plan purchases in 3 months: 384.60 (2026-07-25) + 642.15 (2026-09-02) = 1026.75 (212.30 dated 2026-07-10 is outside) → "500.00 or more | 40.00".
- Open-order cushion (payoff_open_special_order_cushion): SO-0418-571394 status 'in_production', balance_due 1240.00 → "1000.00 or more | 50.00" (others 'completed', 'cancelled' excluded).
- Fixed draft = 2409.00 + 40.00 + 50.00 = **2499.00**.
- Fall-back (computation document alone, after hop 1): 4769.48 × 1.05 / 3 = 1669.32 → 1670.00; with hop 1 also skipped: 5160.00 × 1.05 / 3 → 1806.00. Both definite and different from 2499.00.
- Findability record (words of the records → factor doc): variant 'Card Preferred' + opened_date → allowance-rate table and plan-margin table (both keyed "Card Preferred or Card Premier | Full months open"); credit_type 'delay_credit' / 'order_cancellation' on special order events → late-posting clock ("vendor-delay credits", "order-cancellation credits"); refund event date → flat courtesy ("latest refund date"); purchase_channel 'special_order' → multiplier ("purchase channel is special order"); fee_type 'late_fee' / return lines → payment-history drafts; plan_code 'revolving_standard' purchases → spending add-on; special order status 'in_production' + balance_due → open-order cushion ("in production, shipped or ready … balance due"). KB_search probes on those words returned the relevant doc in the top 1–3 each time. No computation document hinted at any variation.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials

Problems: P0 (root) — payoff autopay at the plan's fixed draft amount; P1 — return credit for the 363.00 special order refund. Direction: P0 waits on P1. Order: P1 then P0.

Hop P0 → P1 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (deferred_interest_payoff_autopay): "The plan's fixed draft amount is not worked out until every special order refund issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name in the last 3 months stands on the account as a return credit."
- Records: special_refund_issued 363.00, refund_method 'ridgeline_consumer_credit', 2026-09-24 (inside 3 months); the card ledger's only card_return_credit_posted is 58.40 on 2026-04-02 against the in-store purchase → the state does not hold.
- Write that brings it about, found with the sentence's own words ("refund … Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender … return credit"): refund_return_credit_posting — "When a Ridgeline selling program has issued a refund to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name and the account does not yet carry it, one return credit is posted for it, referencing the purchase the refund credits and carrying that purchase's plan code and the order number of the refund." Its own tool `post_refund_return_credit_59e816eb` is named only in its own invocation block. Amount from refund_return_credit_amount (+ its factor docs).
- P1 has no prerequisite sentence of its own → tree ends.

Counter-proofs.
- "Do only what the customer asked" (set autopay at once): the blocked document says the amount "is not worked out" while the refund does not stand as a return credit; and doing so leaves the 363.00 refund uncredited and the deferred-interest balance unreduced (draft 1806 + factors instead of the figure on the credited balance). Excluded by the visible sentence plus records.
- Closest alternative tender/object: the 495.00 refund (bank_card) is excluded by "issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender"; 58.40 credit excluded by the 3-month window.
- Closest alternative clock: latest refund date (rule 3) or cancellation-credit date (rule 2) excluded because rule 1 holds (363.00 delay credits = 363.00 refunds).
- Alternative interpretation of "return credit carrying one of those plan codes": the full credit (390.52, allowance included) is what carries deferred_12; no visible sentence restricts it to the refund part.
- Alternative tool owner: autopay "only on the cardholder's own instruction" and "customer-owned tool" exclude the agent running it; return credit "belongs to the agent".

Observations recorded for the dependency-form scan (not judged here): none of the hop-1 documents mentions the payoff plan; the prerequisite sentence appears only in deferred_interest_payoff_autopay (with one same-form restatement "Put the other way: …").
